title: Texora International
summary: A B2B website for a satin scrunchie manufacturer, built to win wholesale and brand enquiries.
problem: Texora makes premium satin scrunchies for wholesalers, boutiques and fashion brands, but had no website to send buyers. Products, capabilities and contact details were shared one chat at a time.
solution: A fast, mobile-first company site that tells the brand story, shows the product range and makes it easy for a buyer to ask for a quote on WhatsApp or by form.

features.title: Quote-first hero
features.description: "Request Price Quote" and "View Products" are the first two things a buyer sees.

features.title: Product range
features.description: Solid colours and printed designs in a clean gallery.

features.title: Brand story
features.description: About section with short videos of the work and why buyers choose Texora.

features.title: Global supply
features.description: What Texora offers wholesalers and brands, with an FAQ for common questions.

features.title: WhatsApp everywhere
features.description: A floating WhatsApp button on every screen, plus a newsletter sign-up.

aiNote: AI turned the client's content PDF into first-draft copy and section layouts that the client then reviewed.
results: A link buyers can trust before the first call
